message:
fix(ka-pc r5): a kept-on replaced viewer counts as its PC; the fence is confirmed only by InputAcks; after it only releases go (Codex R1-a, R3-a, R3-b)

- R1-a every viewer slot carries its hostId; logical_pcs and pc_visible count the viewers a replacement kept
  (gReplacedViewers) per PC -- an old A still open after a failed replacement is one of the three, on screen
- R3-a the control thread counts the input exchanges it runs: taken / acked (the host's InputAck) / failed; the
  fence takes them before its releases and fence_release_verdict confirms only when every exchange since was
  acked -- a failed one is 'NOT confirmed (an exchange failed)' at once; an empty queue or channel is no ack
- R3-b at the fence (UI thread) every queued non-release input is dropped, the pending clipboard text zeroed and the
  clipboard sync turned off (pump_clipboard_sync sends nothing), a password waiting to be sealed zeroed, image /
  file offers stopped; after it the control thread sends releases only (take_release_action straight off the
  queue: no ping-scheduled work, pick, stream state, clipboard, credential or IME align), no resume
- viewer_owner_fence.hpp: the verdict, the cancellation and the release-only take, header-only
- tests (no host): ka_pc_fence_test runs the r4 rule (copied from d81148e) and the r5 code on one fixture -- r4
  claims 'acknowledged' after a failed last release and would send the pending clipboard, r5 does neither;
  ka_pc_shell_logic_test drives the shell's own count: with the r5 lines removed (a mutant) it admits a fourth PC
  (FAIL 3), with them it refuses (PASS)
- test build only: REMOTE60_VIEWER_TEST_FAIL_RELEASE_AFTER_FENCE=1 makes the first release exchange after the fence
  fail. Real-host e2e: not run (the verifier: Codex SOURCE on the shared guard first)
